summary: Section C covers all load-bearing brief requirements — 5-step RBC procedure, 3 normalization conventions, the Bithi 2024 two-interval-in-one-lab illustration, hemolysis-falsely-elevates and EDTA/citrate/oxalate-chelation-falsely-lows with mechanisms, ionized Mg/ISE, and the loading test — with every citation tagged, tiered, and sourced from whitelisted hosts. Spot-checks on Bithi 2024 (PMID 39469428), Lippi 2018 (PMID 29373316), Simundic 2018 (PMID 30004902), and Jahnen-Dechent 2012 (PMID 26069819) all verified first author, co-authors, DOI, and journal. Minor: ref [8] IFCC guideline carries tag 'mechanism_review' where 'regulatory' would be more precise for an issuing-body measurement standard, but this does not misrepresent the source's claims.
